id: title:andehen:label the real baseline in timeseries results text

review.posthog_relevance: Supports the Experimentation feature by dynamically formatting baseline variant names in reports, rather than assuming a hardcoded 'control' name.
review.reason: Adds a helper function to extract the baseline variant key and updates CSV output headers and row labels to use this dynamic value instead of the hardcoded string 'control'. This is a localized, bounded change to the experiment formatting layer.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the observed implementation, not on unverified outcomes like actual experiment adoption or incident avoidance. The benefit is limited to the formatting layer and does not demonstrate broader systemic risk reduction or critical path dependency.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No tier assignment performed.

observations.behavior: Adds a helper function _baseline_key to extract the baseline variant key from the response, defaulting to 'control'. P1.F1.H1: +46,6 to +46,13. Code_quote: "        return "control""
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the experiment formatting layer to support non-'control' baselines, changing the output header and row labels from hardcoded 'control' to the actual baseline key. This could support A/B tests where the baseline is not named 'control'.

observations.behavior: Updates the formatted output to use the extracted baseline_key instead of the hardcoded string 'control' in the header and row labels. P1.F1.H2: +80,16 to +87,17. Code_quote: "        header_row = ["Date", f"{baseline_key} n", f"{baseline_key} mean"]"
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the CSV-like output of the experiment formatter to dynamically display the baseline variant name, rather than always showing 'control'. This makes the report accurate regardless of the baseline name. No score assigned.
